rows.label: tlk70000015_02_msg0001
rows.name:
After the attack, we were starting to
feel pretty pessimistic for a while.

rows.label: tlk70000015_02_msg0002
rows.name:
Leon-kun and Azzaro-kun, the traveling
performers, played beautifully to
cheer us up.

rows.label: tlk70000015_02_msg0003
rows.name:
From familiar songs of Iira to
improvised songs from far lands,
so varied, light, and fun...

rows.label: tlk70000015_02_msg0004
rows.name:
While I was listening to their music,
all thoughts of monsters or the
attack flew clean out of my head.

rows.label: tlk70000015_02_msg0005
rows.name:
I'm sure it was because the performers
were able to share their love of music
with us. It brought us all together.

rows.label: tlk70000015_02_msg0006
rows.name:
Music can overpower anything at times.
They reminded me how wonderful that
power can be.

rows.label: tlk70000015_02_msg0007
rows.name:
Next time, I want to savor their music
at a relaxed gathering just for
enjoying the music.
